title.zh: 谷歌在 Gemini at Work 2026 发布 Gemini Agent 通用工作代理
title.en: Google launches Gemini Agent universal work agent at Gemini at Work 2026

current_state.zh: Google announced a universal Gemini AI agent inside its Gemini Enterprise app that can chat with users and execute tasks across apps and devices in the background, unveiled at the Gemini at Work event.
current_state.en: Google announced a universal Gemini AI agent inside its Gemini Enterprise app that can chat with users and execute tasks across apps and devices in the background, unveiled at the Gemini at Work event.

updates.title_zh: 谷歌云发布Gemini Agent：单一通用工作代理，整合Workspace、多模型路由与企业级治理
updates.title_en: 谷歌云发布Gemini Agent：单一通用工作代理，整合Workspace、多模型路由与企业级治理
updates.what_changed_zh: Google Cloud announced Gemini Agent at Gemini at Work 2026, a single universal work agent that executes goal-driven knowledge work across Workspace and third-party channels with persistent cloud execution, dynamically created sub-agents, multi-model routing between Gemini and Claude, and enterprise identity, sandboxing, and real-time spend controls.
